newsitem.title: DENMARK: Berendsen plunge does little to Danish share index.
newsitem.headline: Berendsen plunge does little to Danish share index.

text.p: Monday's dizzying fall by Sophus Berendsen had little impact on overall Danish share prices but added volume to what had been foreseen as an extremely slack day.
"Sophus put a bit of go into an otherwise very restrained market where there were only small parcels changing hands, a dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index fell 0.04 point to 128.77 in overall bourse turnover of 579 million crowns. The KFX December future fell 0.15 point to 128.60 with 284 contracts, each worth 100,000 crowns, traded.

Berendsen plunged 51 crowns -- seven percent -- to close at 675 crowns after warning that unexpected losses in its Electronic and Data division and the costs of remedial action would cut 1996 profits before tax and associated company earnings to 145 million crowns from last year's 275 million.
The forecast excluded revenues from part-owned companies such as Britain's Rentokil, which contributed 533 million crowns pre-tax to Berendsen's first-half group result of 640 million.
Airline SAS, with third quarter results due on Tuesday, climbed slightly to 72 crowns from Friday's 71.60. --Claus Mathisen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969651
